Must possess valid California Driver's License to drive a County or University vehicle. Ability and means to travel on a flexible schedule as needed, proof of liability damage insurance on vehicle used is required. Reimbursement of job-related travel will be reimbursed according to University policies.
Financial Services Leadership and Management
Operational Services Oversight
Oversee operational services including financial management, budgeting, and fund accounting activities, ensuring integrity of financial operations, reporting, and internal controls.
Ensure effective use and optimization of the financial system.
Research Administration & Grant Management
Provide leadership over pre- and post-award financial management, ensuring compliance with federal, state, and private sponsor requirements.
Partner with the Office of Contracts & Grants and the Controller’s Office to interpret sponsor guidelines and University of California and other institutional policies.
Policy, Compliance & Financial Controls

Collaborate with Central Offices, such as the Controller’s Office, Resource Planning & Management and Human Resources, to interpret and apply University of California, local, state and federal policies, regulations and laws. Help facilitate escalation of high-risk or complex issues.
Strategic Leadership & Team Development

Provide leadership and oversight to the Business & Financial Services Unit. Support employee development through mentorship and training plans, advocating for team and modeling and fostering a culture of accountability, customer service, collaboration, and high performance.
Develop and execute strategic vision for organizational transformation and implementation of new organizational structure, aligned with institutional goals.
Lead change management initiatives to drive continuous improvement, operational effectiveness, and a focus on customer service.
Customer Service & Stakeholder Engagement
Build strong partnerships and collaborations with UC ANR central offices, and unit Directors.
Promote a customer-centric service model, ensuring services are delivered efficiently and seamlessly to enhance the ability of clients to serve the mission.
Monitor and improve service effectiveness and client satisfaction.
Bachelor’s Degree in related area and/or equivalent experience/training.
Minimum of 5 years of experience leading organizational development and managing a large, independent administrative unit.
Strong understanding of change management, employee dynamics, labor relations, and employee communications.
Expert-level people management skills with a track record of coaching and developing teams.
Subject matter expertise in complex financial management, budgeting, and fund accounting.
Demonstrated experience and expertise in research administration and grant management with a strong understanding of sponsor requirements.
Proven ability to build trust and strong working relationships across diverse stakeholder groups.
Strong communication and interpersonal skills, political acumen and ability to work effectively across the organization at all levels.
Advanced degree in business, public administration, or related field.
Familiarity with the University of California system or large public-sector organizations.
Experience working in higher education or the public sector.
Understanding of California labor laws and regulations in a unionized environment.
Experience with Oracle applications and systems.
Special Conditions of Employment:

As of January 1, 2014, ANR is a smoke- and tobacco-free environment in which smoking, the use of smokeless tobacco products, and the use of unregulated nicotine products (e-cigarettes), is strictly prohibited.

Sensitive information includes but is not limited to employee and student records, health and patient records, financial data, strategic plans, proprietary information, and any other sensitive or non-public information learned during the course and scope of employment. Understands that sensitive information should be shared on a limited basis and actively takes steps to limit access to sensitive information to individuals who have legitimate business need to know. Ensure that sensitive information is properly safeguarded.

Follow all organizational policies and laws on data protection and privacy. This includes secure handling of physical and digital records and proper usage of IT systems to prevent data leaks. The unauthorized or improper disclosure of confidential work-related information obtained from any source on any work-related matter is a violation of these expectations.
